falsifier: over 5 extraction sweeps a side, a score of arm B (294bee59) falls by more than 0.5 sd of arm A's (2c29ad31) spread: attribute agreement, flow.authentication or flow.encryption_in_transit agreement, endpoint, interaction, zone or crossings recall
hypothesis: asking extraction for each control as a state and a detail (#2366, merged in #2381 as 294bee59) harms no extraction score of the corpus
intervention: ran 5 extraction sweeps of the 20 corpus cases at 2c29ad31 (main before #2381, arm A) and 5 at 294bee59 (main after #2381, arm B), arm A first, base tier openai/gpt-5.6-luna through OpenRouter pinned to openai/flex; read each case 14 extraction for its placements and zone IDs
reconsider_when: prompts/extract.md rule 3 or rule 5 changes, the case 14 reference zone IDs change, the zone recall scorer stops matching by ID, or the extraction tier's model changes
scope: 20 corpus cases (holdouts 14 and 15 are exhausted and count as development cases), extraction mode, 5 sweeps a side, each arm scored by its own commit's scorer. Arm A 2c29ad31 against arm B 294bee59: zone recall 0.507 to 0.464 (-3.08 sd of A's spread), past the falsifier; endpoint recall 0.781 to 0.796 (+0.62 sd); interaction recall 0.711 to 0.738 (+0.80 sd); crossings recall 0.267 to 0.260 (-0.16 sd); attribute agreement 0.781 to 0.781 (+0.02 sd); flow.authentication agreement 0.898 to 0.916 (+0.92 sd); flow.encryption_in_transit agreement 0.986 to 0.988 (+0.53 sd); store.encryption_at_rest 1.000 on both arms. Case 14 gives the largest zone loss, 0.333 to 0 in 5 of 5 sweeps, about 0.017 of the 0.043 fall; cases 05 and 17 give most of the rest and were not read. In case 14 the elements placed in no zone are 9 (A) against 10 (B) over 5 sweeps; arm A spells the partner zone boundary:partner-servers, the reference ID, in 5 of 5, and arm B spells it partner-app-servers, partner-apps-own-servers or partner-app-own-server in 5 of 5. Zone recall matches by ID, so the one case read shows a spelling change, not a placement change; whether #2381 causes the spelling is not settled. Invalid or stopped extractions: A 5 of 100, B 8 of 100 (7 invalid, and B-r4 stopped at case 20 on a TruncatedCompletionError). Arm B artifacts record the tree as not clean, and they do not name the change; the arm B worktree held the untracked grant file. The falsifier was written at record time from the 0.5 sd convention of QA-2026-11-06-03-E1, not declared before the runs. The maintainer ruled: record, no revert, no further spend. Live downstream effect on findings unmeasured. Figures in evals/experiments/QA-2026-11-25-02/sweeps.txt and cases.txt.
signature: extraction scores move after an extraction schema change: the control fields hold a state and a detail

parity.asvs: the same extracted model reaches ASVS; the extraction scores are package neutral, and the effect on ASVS applicability is unmeasured because no ASVS run was made
parity.stride: the change: the extraction route that every package reads, measured here on the neutral extraction scores

candidate.reason: endpoint recall, interaction recall and flow.authentication agreement fall by more than 0.5 sd, and case 03 fails the gate in 3 of 5 sweeps on an assumption that names a flow ID the model does not hold; the maintainer ruled not to ship

falsifier: over 5 extraction sweeps a side, a score of arm C (142d9807) falls by more than 0.5 sd of arm B's (294bee59) spread, or arm C fails the validity gate on more cases than arm B
hypothesis: when code writes each flow ID on the full extraction route and the prompt asks for none (#2383), no extraction score falls
intervention: branch extraction-flow-id-by-code at 142d9807: the full route stops asking for a flow id, and code writes it from the flow's endpoints and label; ran 5 extraction sweeps of the 20 corpus cases with it (arm C) and compared them with the 5 arm B sweeps of -E1, base tier openai/gpt-5.6-luna through OpenRouter pinned to openai/flex
reconsider_when: assumptions name flows by a reference that code resolves, the extraction prompt's flow rule changes, or the extraction tier's model changes
scope: 20 corpus cases (holdouts 14 and 15 are exhausted and count as development cases), extraction mode, 5 sweeps a side; arm B is the 5 sweeps of -E1, so the arms ran at different times. Arm B 294bee59 against arm C 142d9807: endpoint recall 0.796 to 0.778 (-0.72 sd of B's spread); interaction recall 0.738 to 0.721 (-0.55 sd); flow.authentication agreement 0.916 to 0.904 (-0.87 sd); flow.encryption_in_transit -0.28 sd; zone recall 0.464 to 0.502 (+1.37 sd); crossings recall +0.18 sd; attribute agreement +0.05 sd. Case 03 fails the validity gate in 3 of 5 arm C sweeps and 0 of 5 arm B sweeps: an assumption names a flow by an ID that does not exist in the model (flow:entity:insurance-partner>store:landing-bucket>push extracts twice, flow:entity-insurance-partners>store-landing-bucket>push-files once). Invalid extractions: B 8 of 100 (one a stopped sweep), C 6 of 100. Three scores fall past the falsifier, each inside 1 sd. The maintainer ruled: do not ship; #2383 is closed as not planned. Live downstream effect unmeasured. Figures in evals/experiments/QA-2026-11-25-02/sweeps.txt and cases.txt.
signature: extraction writes a flow id on the full route that code derives again from the flow's fields
